stemMd: What shared standard links the two passages?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every failed replication proves deliberate misconduct.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Visible procedural similarity guarantees relevant sameness.

options.label: C
options.textMd: A favored theory should survive any outcome.

options.label: D

explanationMd: The first demands a new opportunity to be wrong, and the second demands predictions about new settings. These are two formulations of the same requirement that explanations restrict future expectations.

distractorRationale.c: The first directly rejects that immunity.
